https://status.example.com/

Customers see only the notices your team posts. Visitors see times in their own time zone, or in UTC when their browser runs no JavaScript. The public page changes only when someone posts.

No open notices: the public page says that everything is working.

Affected components (optional)
Where status page settings are set

Set in TEMPORARY-DIRECTORY/mmhotline_settings.yml, in status_page. The file's first line says: Managed by MMX from mmhotline_settings.yml in the systems repository. Change it there and push; util01 applies it.

Times are New York time (America/New_York), the team's time zone.
